title: A collectible lookup answer or error is applied to whichever lookup is open, not the one that asked
trigger: Tap a collectible username/phone row on profile A, then before the answer arrives tap one on profile B (second tap replaces hub.collectible and sends a second request). A's answer (or COLLECTIBLE_NOT_FOUND) lands.
effect: The box for B shows A's purchase date and price under B's name and owner; or A's not-found error marks B failed, so B's link is copied and its real answer is dropped. Applies by purpose only (state/domains/payments/apply.rs:25, error.rs:64); CollectibleLookup holds no request id.
fix: Make the lookup an enum Loading{request: RequestId} / Ready(info) / Failed(reason) and apply an answer or error only when its extra equals the Loading request id.

title: open_earn_page leaves ton and stars in Loading when a later send fails
trigger: Open Monetization or Stars Balance and a send_earn returns Err (client closing, send error): the first `?` returns after the page was stored with ton/stars = Loading
effect: The page spinner stays; stars Load::Loading is never settled because no request was sent for it (only TON history gets inspect_err). The UI shows a toast but the page itself never leaves loading until it is reopened
fix: Set Load::Loading only after the send succeeds, or on Err set both Loads to Failed

title: fetch_earn_balances records the peer as asked before sending and an error answer never clears it
trigger: Open a channel/bot profile when the balance request fails (apply_earn_error ignores TonBalance/StarBalance) or the send fails.
effect: The balance row never loads again for that peer in this session; balances_asked only grows.
fix: Fetch<T> per peer balance (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed) instead of a visited Vec.

title: balances_asked is pushed before the request is sent and never cleared on failure
trigger: Open a channel or bot profile while the send fails or the TON/Stars balance request errors (apply_earn_error ignores TonBalance and StarBalance)
effect: The peer stays in balances_asked, so fetch_earn_balances returns early forever; the profile Monetization or Stars row never shows its balance this session. Also the Vec is a started flag with no way back
fix: HashMap<EarnPeer, BalanceFetch> with Asking(RequestId) / Known / Failed, cleared on error so a reopen asks again

title: fetch_earn_balances marks the peer asked before the requests are sent, so a failed send is never retried
trigger: Open a bot or channel profile (earn_balances_upkeep runs per frame) at a moment send_earn fails (driver busy or closed); the peer is already pushed to balances_asked. Also a TonBalance/StarBalance error answer is ignored (apply_earn_error arm is empty).
effect: The Monetization / Stars Balance rows on that profile never show their balance for the rest of the session; nothing asks again.
fix: Replace the Vec<EarnPeer> with a per-peer enum (Unasked, Asked(RequestId), Ready, Failed) set after a successful send and reset by the error arm.

title: A withdrawal in WithdrawStep::Checking has no visible UI and no way out; Collect and Withdraw then do nothing silently
trigger: Press Collect or Withdraw; while the first request is unanswered the dialog predicate is false for Checking, and start_withdrawal returns Ok(()) early when withdraw is Some. If the answer is slow or lost, every later click is ignored with no toast until an account switch or reopen of the dialog (nothing cancels it).
effect: Collect/Withdraw buttons appear dead; the user cannot cancel or retry.
fix: Show the box (or a spinner on the button) for Checking with a Cancel, and make a repeated click tell the user a withdrawal is pending; cancel it when the earn layer closes.

title: Program-list answers are not keyed to the sort or request that asked them
trigger: In the affiliate join page change 'Sort by' twice quickly, or scroll for more while changing sort.
effect: SearchPrograms{for_box,append} is the only key: an older answer lands in the reset list (wrong order shown until the later answer; a stale append adds old-sort rows to the new list). fetch_found_programs also sends a second non-append page while one is loading.
fix: Carry a generation in SearchPrograms and in ProgramList, drop mismatched answers, and gate non-append starts on is_loading.

title: One failed send of the two recipient requests caches a partial recipient list for the session
trigger: Open an affiliate program as the user while the chats send works and the bots send fails (or the reverse, e.g. a send error between the two)
effect: request_earn_recipients resets recipients_loading to 0 and recipients to None and returns Err, but the request that did go out still answers: add_earn_recipients makes recipients Some(me + channels). From then on recipients.is_some() makes request_earn_recipients return early, so owned bots (or channels) are never offered as commission recipients until the account is reopened
fix: Recipients enum with a Failed stage that ignores late answers of the abandoned attempt (match by request id) and allows a retry

title: limits_asked is set before the limit requests and never cleared when they fail
trigger: Open a gifts list when getOption sends fail (offline moment); GetGiftOption errors are swallowed.
effect: For the rest of the session pin/collection/resale limits stay at their defaults and are never asked again.
fix: Fetch<GiftLimits>: Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed with retry on the next gifts open.

title: Closing Send a Gift while sendGift is out loses its result
trigger: Press Send on a Stars gift, close the dialog before the answer.
effect: close_send_gift clears done/error but leaves sending/request; the OK sets done on a closed dialog and an error is never shown, so the user is not told whether Stars were spent.
fix: SendStage::Sending(request) that closing keeps, with the answer posted as a toast (ok or error) when the dialog is no longer open.

title: start_gift_resale_buy / open_gift_resale / open_gift_craft replace buy and craft sessions that have a request in flight
trigger: Start a purchase (buy.sending, Stars spent), then start another buy, open another resale list, or open the craft box before the answer.
effect: The old ResaleBuy/CraftSession is dropped: its answer is ignored (outcome unseen) and the new buy is not sending, so the user can pay twice.
fix: Refuse to replace while sending/crafting; make ResaleBuy a stage enum.

title: followed is set before openGiftAuction is sent and a failed follow is never retried
trigger: Open an auction bid box while the connection drops (send error or TdError on openGiftAuction).
effect: gift_market.followed stays Some(new) so the per-frame follow_gift_auction(same) returns early forever: the bid box never receives live updates, and OpenAuction/CloseAuction errors are ignored in apply_gift_market_error.
fix: enum Follow { None, Opening(gift_id), Following(gift_id) } that returns to None on the error arm so the next frame retries.

title: follow_gift_auction sets followed before the open request and never unfollows on logout or account switch
trigger: Open an auction box when the follow send fails; or leave the box open and switch accounts.
effect: followed = new id, so the retry returns early (updates never start); the old account stays subscribed to auction updates.
fix: Set followed after the send succeeds; close the follow in the owner's Farewell.

title: Appending a boosts page never sets BoostsListState::loading
trigger: Open a channel's Boosts list, click 'Show more'; the button stays because loading is still false, click again
effect: No spinner, a second getChatBoosts with the same offset is sent and the first answer is dropped (request id no longer matches); wasted requests
fix: Make the list a Fetch-like enum (Idle/Loading{request,append}/Ready/Failed) so request and loading cannot disagree; derive loading from the request

title: A failed send of a next-page request deletes the already loaded list
trigger: Scroll to 'Show more' in boosts / invite-link members / link join requests / join request search while the sender is down
effect: The loaded rows vanish (list removed or closed) instead of keeping them with an error; same pattern at invite_admin.rs:294 (members), links_boosts.rs:219 (join requests), invite_admin.rs:69 (search drops the previous list)
fix: On append failure only clear the in-flight request and set error on the existing Ready state; remove the entry only for the first page

title: release_paid_send takes the held send out of the guard before the send and loses it if the send fails
trigger: Confirm the paid-message price while the sender refuses.
effect: take_held removed the request; send_json Err is returned to the caller and the user's message is gone with no way to retry from the box (the pending entry is also never taken).
fix: Peek the held send, send, and take it only on success; or return it to the guard on Err.

title: A Star reaction whose commit request fails is dropped with an unseen note
trigger: Tap the Star chip and let the Undo window end while the commit request cannot be sent (send_json_request returns Err).
effect: take_due already removed the pending Stars, so the toast vanishes and the Stars are never committed; the 'Stars were not sent' note is written to paid.note, which only the next add_paid reads, so the user is never told.
fix: Keep the pending entry in a Committing/Failed stage until TDLib answers CommitPaidReaction; on failure surface a toast through the status note and offer retry or drop.

title: A failed commit send drops the pending reaction and only sets a note
trigger: Undo window ends while the sender refuses.
effect: take_due already removed the entry; the note says Stars were not sent but TDLib still holds the pending Stars with no local entry to undo or retry.
fix: Put the entry back (Committing stage) when the send fails.

title: payments.request, form_request and validate_request are set before the send and not cleared when the send fails
trigger: Tap Buy or Validate while the sender refuses (client closing, send_json_request Err). send_payment_form_request (lines 36-45) and validate_payment_order_info (49-62) store request/form_request/validate_request first and return the Err without clearing them.
effect: The checkout keeps an invoice and a request id that never get an answer; the dialog can wait on a form that never comes and later answers are matched to a dead id.
fix: One Checkout stage enum (Idle, FetchingForm(RequestId), Validating(RequestId), Ready, Paying) set only after the send succeeds.

title: refresh_star_subscriptions_if_stale clears stale before the send and ignores an in-flight fetch
trigger: Cancel a subscription; the ok marks the list stale; the refetch send fails (or a fetch_more page is in flight when it runs).
effect: On a failed send stale is already false, so the list stays old with no retry; with a page in flight a second first-page request races the append page and answers are matched only by the append flag, not by a key.
fix: Keep Stale until the answer lands (Fetch::Stale) and key the answer by RequestId.

title: Collectible lookup answer is not matched to the entity that asked
trigger: Tap a collectible username, then before the answer tap another collectible phone/username.
effect: hub.collectible is replaced by the second lookup, but RequestPurpose::GetCollectibleInfo carries no entity, so the first answer is applied to the second lookup and shows the wrong info; dedupe only compares the stored entity.
fix: Carry the lookup entity (or a generation) in the purpose and apply the answer only when it equals the current lookup.

title: open_received_gifts resets gift_mutating while a toggle or sell for the previous owner is in flight
trigger: Tap Convert to Stars on own gifts, immediately open another owner's gifts (or reopen the own list).
effect: gift_mutating=false lets a second mutation start while sellGift/toggleGiftIsSaved is in flight; its answer then marks the new owner's list stale and shows the old mutation's result against the new list.
fix: Key the mutation by (owner, RequestId) and keep it until its own answer; reset only the list stage.

title: A send failure on the first page of gifts or Stars after a tab switch leaves an empty list with no spinner and no error
trigger: Be briefly disconnected (chats_path_active false is checked first, but send_json_request can fail), open someone's gifts or switch the Stars tab; the UI ignores the Err for the tab switch (set_star_transactions_filter).
effect: open_received_gifts has already set gifts_open and cleared the list; fetch_received_gifts_page resets gifts_loading=false and sets no gifts_error. The box shows neither loading nor error nor rows. set_star_transactions_filter likewise clears transactions and tx_error stays None. set_grams_filter in connect/grams.rs does the same (error only set in open_grams).
fix: Fetch<T> with a Failed variant written on the send-failure arm, so every first-page start ends in Loading or Failed.

title: Reopening the gifts dialog resets gift_mutating while a mutation is in flight
trigger: Gifts dialog > confirm Upgrade (or Transfer/Pin) > close the dialog and reopen My Gifts before the answer.
effect: open_received_gifts sets hub.gift_mutating=false, which the UI uses to enable Upgrade/Transfer/Resale/Delete buttons (gift_owner_actions.rs busy), so a second request can be sent for the same gift; the first answer then clears the flag for the new list.
fix: Make the mutation an enum (Idle, Mutating{request, gift}) owned by the session and not reset by open; match answers by request id.

title: refresh_received_gifts_if_stale clears stale before the send and ignores an in-flight page
trigger: Convert or hide a gift; the refetch send fails or runs while a next page is in flight.
effect: On Err stale is false so the gifts list keeps showing a converted gift with no retry; with a page in flight the first-page request overwrites gifts_request and the older answer is ignored, leaving gifts_loading true until the new answer.
fix: Fetch<Gifts> with Stale variant cleared only by the answer.

title: getStarGiftPaymentOptions answer is not matched to the contact or request that asked it
trigger: Open Gift Stars, pick contact A (request 1 in flight), tap Back, pick contact B (request 2); answer 1 lands after the target changed, or lands after Back/close.
effect: apply StarPackOptions writes options/loading=false into stars_gift for whatever target is current (even none), so B's pack list can be A's, and an answer after close fills a closed dialog. Requests are never dropped by clear_target or close_stars_gift.
fix: Carry the asking RequestId inside the LoadingPacks stage and accept an answer only when it matches; drop the pending request in clear_target/close.

title: One-shot gift results (deleted, transferred, export_url) are consumed by whichever window runs the transfer upkeep
trigger: Delete or transfer a gift from a gifts box hosted in a chat window.
effect: deleted/transferred/export_url sit in the Session until a window whose dialog_may_show_in(GiftTransfer) runs gift_transfer_frame_upkeep; the toast, Fragment page or the recipient's chat may open in the main window or late; reset_for_owner leaves them set.
fix: Post these as events naming the asking window and clear them in reset_for_owner.

title: A failed canSendMessageToUser leaves the chat ungated and blocks a retry for 30 s
trigger: Open a private chat with a user who charges Stars while the request fails (flood wait, network error). apply_privacy_data_error for CanSendMessageToUser does nothing and never calls ask_failed (only a failed send does).
effect: `asking` keeps the user for ASK_TIMEOUT_MS (wall clock) so re-opening the chat does not ask again; the composer shows no price and PaidGuard has no price for the chat, so the send goes to TDLib unannounced and fails with a server error instead of the Stars confirmation. The stage (none / asking / answered / failed) is split over `gates`, `asking` and two timestamps.
fix: enum GateFetch { Unknown, Asking{at}, Known{answer,at}, Failed{at} } per user; the error arm moves Asking to Failed and the send path refuses while the gate is not Known.

title: PaidMessages::forget_answers is never called, so the Premium gate stays stale after the viewer buys Premium
trigger: Open a private chat with a user who restricts new chats (composer shows 'only accepts messages from contacts and Premium users'). Buy/receive Premium (updateOption is_premium / user update). The doc says 'After the viewer's Premium changes, old answers are wrong'.
effect: `forget_answers` has no caller outside its test (grep). The cached CanSend::RestrictsNewChats answer is only refreshed by `should_ask` after GATE_REFRESH_MS (5 minutes) and only on a chat open, so the composer stays blocked by the Premium prompt although the viewer now has Premium (send_gate reads viewer_premium only when it rebuilds, but PremiumRequired is computed live from my_is_premium; the opposite case, a Premium that lapses, keeps Free for up to 5 minutes and the send is rejected by the server). Price answers for other users are not re-asked either.
fix: Call forget_answers (and sync_paid_guard) from the Session's is_premium change, or key the cached answer by the viewer's Premium flag so a change makes it stale by construction.

title: rollback after a refused addPending is matched by chat+message, not by the tap that failed
trigger: Tap Star reaction on a message (request E1 fails slowly, e.g. flood), tap again after the timer fired so a new entry for the same message exists, then E1's error arrives.
effect: rollback subtracts E1's stars from the newer entry (or removes it), so the toast and the reserved total differ from what TDLib holds, and a later commit sends a different amount than shown.
fix: Give each tap an id (the request id) stored in the pending item and roll back only that tap.

title: Premium gift message is cut to nothing when gift_text_length_max is not known yet
trigger: Sign in, open a user's profile > Gift Premium before the gift_text_length_max option arrives (or it failed: error arm sets it to None), type a message and pay. invoice_checkout.rs:138 passes `gift_text_length_max.unwrap_or(0)`.
effect: `text.trim().chars().take(0)` yields an empty string, so a paid Premium gift (Stars or card) is sent without the message the sender wrote, with no warning.
fix: Treat an unknown limit as 'ask first' (disable Pay until Fetch<usize> is Ready) or as no cut, never as 0.

title: Closing the checkout while sendPaymentForm is in flight leaves the payment's outcome unreported
trigger: Press Pay on a non-paid-media invoice (Stars or card) and close the checkout before TDLib answers
effect: close_checkout (checkout.rs) clears request, so shows(invoice) is false: apply.rs:75-98 sets nothing for success, and error.rs:37-43 sets no note for failure; note_paid_media_unlocked only reports paid media. Money may be spent (or refused) with no toast or note
fix: A PaymentInFlight outcome that is always pushed to the status-note queue when the checkout is not showing it.

title: Receipt answer reopens a closed receipt dialog and is not matched to the invoice that asked
trigger: View receipt, press Esc before it arrives (receipt_open=false, receipt=None), or tap View receipt on invoice A then B
effect: apply.rs:163-166 sets receipt and receipt_open=true for any GetPaymentReceipt answer: the dialog pops back open after the user dismissed it, and A's receipt can show for B until B's answer replaces it. receipt_error (error.rs:44) is also unmatched
fix: enum Receipt{Closed,Loading{request,invoice},Open(data),Failed}; answers apply only to Loading with the same request.

title: Program list answers are not matched to the sort or offset that asked
trigger: Scroll the programs list (an append page is in flight) then change Sort by; or change Sort twice quickly
effect: set_starref_sort resets join.found, but SearchPrograms{for_box,append} answers carry no sort/offset/request id: an older answer that lands after the newer one (or an old append landing on the fresh list) shows programs in the old order with the old next_offset, and later pages continue from the wrong offset
fix: Carry the RequestId (or a list generation) in ProgramList::load = Loading { request } and apply only the answer of that request
